dataset.selection: fixed parent indices before outcomes; calibration and test prompts disjoint

watermark.keys: one independently generated fixed key set per layout, reused for every image; fixed before calibration
watermark.algorithms: unchanged authors KeyGen/Encode/sample/recover_posteriors/Detect; defaults g,r,noise recomputed for patch block length
watermark.seed_domains: documented integer stream bases 3000000000 through 3600000000, + variant_index*1000000 + image_index*1000 + patch

alignment.attack: remove 6 pixels from each border:512 to500; bilinear resize to512 using existing verified renderer

evaluation.primary: arithmetic mean of normalized PRC patch scores; for count1 this is the original unpatched score
evaluation.threshold: maximum score on20 separate cropped unmarked images; strict greater-than
evaluation.original_rule: secondary original any-patch threshold; not matched-FPR
evaluation.uncertainty: prompt-level resampling conditional on the fixed key set and realized calibration set; not uncertainty over alternative keys
evaluation.clean: first two prompt slots only as implementation diagnostics
evaluation.selection: no tuning or positive/test outcomes used for threshold selection

retention: retain all prompts and results; never reject a key/seed for detection failure; pilot slots retained in the100 tests
